title: Silicon Quantum Computing Appoints Former GlobalFoundries CFO John Hollister To Lead Financial Strategy
excerpt: Silicon Quantum Computing has appointed semiconductor industry veteran John Hollister as Chief Financial Officer as the Australian quantum computing company advances its roadmap toward commercial-scale systems.
content:
Silicon Quantum Computing has appointed semiconductor industry veteran John Hollister as Chief Financial Officer as the Australian quantum computing company advances its roadmap toward commercial-scale systems.

Hollister, who is based in the U.S., assumed the role effective August 17 and will oversee SQC’s global financial strategy and operations.

He brings more than 25 years of semiconductor financial leadership and previously served as CFO of GlobalFoundries.

Earlier, Hollister spent two decades at Silicon Labs, including 11 years as CFO, and also held positions at Cicada Semiconductor and Cirrus Logic.

His experience spans capital formation, financial planning and analysis, accounting, reporting, M&A, tax and investor relations.

The appointment strengthens SQC’s leadership team as it moves toward commercialization of quantum computing technology built around atomic-precision manufacturing.

SQC says its technology allows it to manufacture silicon chips with atomic precision and operate in-house quantum processing unit manufacturing. The company can iterate new chips weekly while also supplying quantum-enhanced AI and materials-simulation systems to customers.

SQC is also one of 11 companies selected for Stage B of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative.

Hollister joins shortly after SQC appointed Karna Nisewaner as Chief Legal Officer, adding executives with extensive operational experience from semiconductor and technology businesses.

KEY QUOTES:

“John brings a track record of financial rigor and expertise that is critical to advancing our commercial roadmap and scaling our world-leading manufacturing technology.”

Michelle Simmons, Founder and CEO of Silicon Quantum Computing

“Bringing quantum computing to the world is a massive opportunity, and SQC’s atomic-precision manufacturing capability gives us a distinct commercial and scientific advantage.”

John Hollister, Chief Financial Officer of Silicon Quantum Computing
